tasks.spec:
You are a code worker. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. Edit files here directly. Do NOT git commit, push or touch .git. You own only: storygame/runtime/engine.py and tests (tests/*.py). Edit nothing else; do not touch story data (data/), plans or docs. Never weaken or delete an existing test; if one pins behaviour you must change, change only its expectation and say so in notes.md.

Problem. In RuntimeEngine._activate_pacing (storygame/runtime/engine.py ~390-410) a cue (FactDelivery.cue_text, shown to the player as a hint) is staged for the next missing bridge fact even when the player cannot yet earn the reveal that sets that fact, because the reveal's `requires` are unmet. Example: scene 1B shows the storm-drain cue before Brandon is identified, so players act on the last step first and nothing fires. Rule to build, story-neutral (no scene ids, fact ids or story names in the code): STAGE A CUE ONLY ONCE THE REVEAL BEHIND IT IS AVAILABLE.

Definition. For a delivery fact_id F in the current scene, the reveals behind it are the entries of self.state.package.knowledge.knowledge (KnowledgeDefinition, storygame/story_package/models.py ~107) where self.state.current_scene_id is in available_in_scenes and some item in `establishes` has op == 'assert' and fact_id == F. Add a private helper on RuntimeEngine, e.g. `_cue_reveal_available(self, fact_id) -> bool`: if no such reveal exists, return True (nothing gates it, keep today's behaviour). Otherwise return True when at least one of those reveals has every predicate in its `requires` satisfied by the current facts, using predicate_matches(predicate, self.state.facts) exactly as _apply_world_actions (~line 494) does. Otherwise False.

Use it in _activate_pacing in BOTH places that choose a cue: (1) the next(...) that picks a new staged cue from self._ranked_cue_fact_ids() must skip fact ids whose reveal is not available (continue to the next ranked one; if none qualifies the staged cue is None); (2) the 'keep the already staged cue' condition must also require the staged cue to be available. Do NOT change _ranked_cue_fact_ids itself (tests/test_pacing_handoff.py ~336 pins its order). Do NOT touch handoff staging (staged_handoff_fact_ids), the timer, or delivery. Do not change the carry-over of a staged cue across a scene change at ~line 194.

Tests (hermetic, no live model; use the patterns in tests/test_pacing_handoff.py, e.g. `_state_1b`, RuntimeEngine, PACKAGE on data/stories/continuity-initiative). Add tests/test_staged_cues.py with: (a) a state whose first-ranked missing bridge fact has a reveal with an unmet `requires` does not get that cue staged, and the next ranked available cue is staged instead; (b) once the required fact is asserted the withheld cue is staged on the next _activate_pacing; (c) a fact with no reveal in the scene is staged as before; (d) a staged cue whose reveal is unavailable is dropped, not kept; (e) with the real package at scene 1B before brandon_identified is asserted, state.staged_cue_fact_id is never the storm-drain cue (the delivery for park_pursuit_resolved) across engine._activate_pacing(); after asserting brandon_identified it can be. Build small packages with model_copy(update=...) as test_pacing_handoff.py does when you need a synthetic reveal. Then run the whole suite; if existing tests fail because a cue is now correctly withheld, update only that test's expectation and list each in notes.md with the reason.

Run: `TMPDIR=/tmp uv run pytest -q` (all pass) and `uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .`. Write notes.md at the worktree root: the edit with line numbers, each test, each existing expectation changed and why.
